findings.label: Missing tailwind theme.extend animation config
findings.description: animation and keyframes entries were not added to theme.extend in tailwind.config.ts as the spec required. The full .animate-marquee rule lives in globals.css instead. Add animation/keyframes to theme.extend and keep only the .animate-marquee:hover rule in globals.css.

findings.label: Duplicate icon registration in <head>
findings.description: src/app/icon.svg triggers Next.js App Router file-based icon auto-registration, and metadata.icons in layout.tsx adds a second set of <link rel="icon"> tags. The result is three icon link elements in <head> across two different paths. Delete src/app/icon.svg to leave metadata.icons as the single source of truth.
